svg.title: The Cortexel honesty contract: a caption that cannot be suppressed
svg.desc: Provenance starts at a fail-closed baseline and can only gain rigor. The honesty caption is composed in one fixed order: contract-owned weak-skill disclosure, contract-owned external-provenance disclosure, flag-derived mandatory disclosure, then a sanitized explicitly unverified caller note. calibrated_posterior true is rejected at every entrypoint, and caller text can never replace or reorder a contract segment.
svg.text: The honesty contract — a caption that cannot be suppressed
Provenance fails closed; captions derive from machine-checkable flags, never from caller claims.
Fail-closed provenance baseline
conservativeProvenance(source, declaredInputs)
calibrated_posterior : false
true is rejected at every entrypoint
advisory_only : true
is_paper_local_evidence : false
synthetic : false
declared_inputs : strict claims
required keys checked, unknown keys rejected
A caller can only ever ADD rigor.
Any non-rigorous flag forces the caption on:
requiresHonestyCaption = synthetic
|| !calibrated_posterior || advisory_only
|| !is_paper_local_evidence
Caption composition — one fixed order, no reordering
Contract-owned weak-skill disclosure
derived for weak skills: schematic topology positions, astrocyte signals are
not membrane voltage; corpus assertions are derived/advisory
Contract-owned external-provenance disclosure
declared external sources and population labels remain contract-disclosed
claims — Cortexel does not authenticate the producing simulator
Flag-derived mandatory disclosure
"Schematic — illustrative synthetic data, not measured." /
"Advisory — not paper-local evidence; candidate ranking only."
Caller note (unverified) — appended last, always
free-text capped at 500 chars; C0/C1 controls, bidi overrides and isolates,
zero-width marks and BOM escaped; isolated so it cannot visually reorder text
a caption is bound to every accepted spec — composeHonestyCaption never null
Both strict gates (scene-backed and host-renderer) use this single composition rule.
ReferenceVizSpecFigure and VizSpecRenderer keep the caption below the figure.
Invariants enforced in code, not convention
calibrated_posterior: true is rejected at every entrypoint
buildVizSpec, validateSkillInvocation, validateHostRendererInvocation — early raw-payload check + z.literal(false)
Caller text cannot suppress or reorder contract segments
provenance.caption is only ever appended as "Caller note (unverified): …" after all contract-owned segments
No figure without a caption
every ok result of both gates carries the bound caption; rejected states render an explicit alert, never a silent figure
cortexel 0.10.0-dev.0 — docs/diagrams/honesty-contract.svg — core/provenance.ts, core/skills/validateSkillInvocation.ts, src/core/errors.ts
